scope: filetamper.py whole file read, pinned Git blob verified. Original main invoked for one temporary authored file with probability zero; fails before any byte change.

result.message: tamper_file() got an unexpected keyword argument 'silent'

findings.detail: main passes silent keyword to tamper_file, whose signature has no such parameter. Original single-file CLI fails with TypeError before changing the fixture. Directory wrapper removes silent before calling tamper_file, so this finding is specific to single-file CLI.
not block_proba treats explicit 0 as disabled block filtering, equivalent to processing all blocks instead of selecting none. Static finding, no mutation reproduction run.

tamper_count counts selected positions, not bytes actually changed. Erasing existing zeros and random noise equal to original count as tampering; reported rate is selection rate, not measured corruption rate.

proba>=1 normalizes by total file size, causing division by zero on empty files; CLI accepts unbounded floats and arbitrary mode strings. Burst remaining resets per block, truncating bursts at block boundaries. These are source-level findings.
tamper_file_at defaults replacement to Python str null, then writes to binary handle. TypeError is not caught by its IOError handler. Not executed.

relation_to_goal: Useful for designing corruption fixtures and interpreting test metrics; not a duplicate-detection algorithm. No production code copied.
